events.verdict: Williamson (NOP) trips Williams Jr. (MEM) as he defends the drive.
Alvarado (NOP) and Williams Jr. (MEM) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Edey (MEM) and Williamson (NOP) briefly engage and disengage following the expiration of the pick.
Missi (NOP) blocks Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
Murphy III (NOP) brushes Edey's (MEM) arm as he defends the shot, and the contact is marginal.
Williams Jr. (MEM) and Alvarado (NOP) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Williams Jr. (MEM) defends Murphy III's (NOP) drive, and the contact after Murphy III has passed the ball is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) grasps Williamson's (NOP) jersey as they pursue the rebound.
Williams Jr. (MEM) loses control of the ball on his own and not as a result of any contact from Murphy III (NOP).
Missi (NOP) establishes himself in Wells' (MEM) path prior to the contact.
Alvarado (NOP) does not step out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Alvarado (NOP) grabs and holds Wells' (MEM) arm and affects his ability to defend the drive.
Edey (MEM) maintains verticality as he defends Williamson's (NOP) shot attempt.
Missi (NOP) moves alongside Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Edey (MEM) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes contact with the ball as he defends Williamson's (NOP) drive.  Any ensuing contact to Williamson's head is considered marginal.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Wells (MEM) legally contests Alvarado's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Bey (NOP) and Coward (MEM) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Coward (MEM) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Missi's (NOP) hand that is on the ball, as he defends the shot attempt.
Coward (MEM) does not overtly, or abruptly, extend his leg into Alvarado's (NOP) midsection following the release of his pass.
Williams Jr. (MEM) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before releasing the pass.
Murphy III (NOP) initiates contact with Edey's (MEM) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Williams Jr. (MEM) enters the lane prior to the release of the free throw attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) dislodges the ball from Williamson (NOP).
Jackson Jr. (MEM) deflects the ball as he defends Williamson's (NOP) drive.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) legally contests Williamson's (NOP) shot attempt.
Alvarado (NOP) and Spencer (MEM) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Bey (NOP) deflects the ball away from Edey (MEM).
Alvarado (NOP) dislodges the ball from Coward (MEM).
Alvarado (NOP) initiates contact with Coward's (MEM) body that affects his shot attempt.
Bey (NOP) deflects the ball away from Edey (MEM).
Murphy III (NOP) dislodges the ball from Coward (MEM).
Edey (MEM) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he maintains prior to passing the ball.
Wells (MEM) extends his arm into Williamson's (NOP) path and initiates body contact prior to making any contact with the ball.
Williamson (NOP) establishes himself in Wells' (MEM) path prior to the contact.
Wells (MEM) legally contests Alvarado's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Williams Jr. (MEM) is moving alongside Williamson's (NOP) path as he defends the drive.
Williams Jr. (MEM) cleanly dislodges the ball from Williamson (NOP).
Alvarado (NOP commits a take foul on Williams Jr. (MEM).
Missi (NOP) firms up over his left leg in Coward's (MEM) path prior to the contact.
Bey (NOP) cleanly ties up Edey (MEM) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Edey (MEM) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Pelicans.
Alvarado (NOP) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
Williams Jr. (MEM) pulls Williamson's (NOP) jersey away from his body and affects his FOM during the inbound.
